payers.no_fax_reason: CGS does not accept redeterminations or reopenings by fax. Job aid (rev. 12/16/2025): 'Utilizing the myCGS Web portal is the preferred method for submitting your Redetermination ... Redeterminations should be mailed to the address at the bottom of the form. Redeterminations do not accept faxed request.' Telephone reopenings ended 08/01/2026. The only faxes CGS publishes are for congressional offices, general correspondence (615.782.4490), overpayment recovery (KY 615.664.5916) and Medical Review ADR records (KY 615-664-5964). Second level (QIC Part B North) does take fax: 904-539-4081.
conflicts: Redetermination mail: form says 'CGS, Attn: J15 Part B Appeals Department, PO Box 20018'; addresses page says 'J15 - Part A/B Correspondence ... PO Box 20018' for appeals. Same box; use the form's attention line.
Job aid says a redetermination is due '120 days from the initial claim determination'; the CGS appeals page and CMS say 120 days from receipt (date of notice + 5 days). Use receipt.

CGS reconsideration form (2017) and CGS level-2 page point to C2C QIC Part B North; the myCGS manual says 'The QICs for our jurisdiction are C2C Innovative Solutions, Inc. (C2C) and Maximus' because Part A goes to other QICs. For Part B use QIC Part B North (MCPM 29 sec. 320.7) unless the decision letter names another.
CGS PWK fax (KY 1.615.664.5952, 2018 cover sheet) is for unsolicited documentation with an electronic claim and must not be used for ADR responses.
payers.notes: myCGS log-in: https://www.onlineproviderservices.com/cgs_ops/ (needs an EDI enrollment agreement per NPI/PTAN). Part B reconsiderations cannot be filed in myCGS (2nd level there is Part A/HHH only). ASCA: paper claims only for small providers (MCPM 24 sec. 90). Overpayment appeals are redeterminations; reopenings of recoupment claims go to Overpayment Recovery (job aid).
